title: Jaxroxn Pack
description: This pack contains all the important resource packs.
body:
## **_Jaxroxn Pack Description_**

JaxroxnPack modernizes Minecraft’s visuals while keeping the familiar vanilla atmosphere intact. The pack improves clarity, reduces visual clutter, and makes important elements easier to recognize. Perfect for PvP, Survival, and anyone who prefers a clean and practical visual style.

## Features:

- Low Fire
Fire is significantly lowered to keep your screen clear during combat.

- No Pumpkin Overlay
The obstructive pumpkin view has been removed.

- Clean & clearer item textures
Reworked icons for better readability and a more consistent look.

- Optimized armor and tool details
Materials are easier to distinguish at a glance.

- Improved GUI elements
Clearer menus and a more organized interface.

- Refined particle effects
Visible without being distracting.

- Vanilla-friendly aesthetic
All improvements stay true to the original Minecraft style.

## Goal:

A clean, practical, and easy-to-read visual experience that makes Minecraft feel more modern without losing its classic charm.
